findings.title: A Series of Unauthenticated Events: Chained Exploitation of Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Days
findings.summary_md: Volexity documented in-the-wild exploitation of a three-bug chain giving unauthenticated root code execution on a fully patched Connect Secure 22.8R2.4 (Build 19097) appliance, exploited from October 3, 2026 by a previously unknown actor tracked as UTA0576. The chain combines an authentication bypass in `welcome.cgi` that routes requests to arbitrary CGI files via an `X-DSCGI-PATH` header, a file-write race in `wu.cgi` that lands scripts under `/home/runtime/tmp/`, and a privilege escalation in the `dsinvoked` broker's trust of DSCache configuration data. The actor dumped appliance credentials and Active Directory secrets including LAPS passwords and BitLocker recovery keys, then deleted evidence from Ivanti debug logs and Linux audit logs, with command traffic carried inside the exploit chain's own HTTPS requests. The RCE and authentication bypass are tracked under CVE-2026-104935; the privilege escalation was unpatched at disclosure time.

findings.title: CVE-2026-104935: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing (watchTowr intelligence note)
findings.summary_md: watchTowr published an intelligence note on CVE-2026-104935 describing it as an authentication bypass by spoofing in Ivanti Connect Secure that lets a remote attacker run commands without logging in. The note relays the vendor's confirmation of exploitation in the wild and urges immediate updates for affected branches.

findings.title: Security Advisory Ivanti Connect Secure (CVE-2026-104935) - Ivanti
findings.summary_md: Ivanti's PSIRT advisory for Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 was published on October 13, 2026, before the Canadian Centre advisory the story is built on (date per Rapid7's same-day ETR post and the NVD record; the Ivanti portal is JavaScript-rendered and was read through those sources). It maps affected lines to fixed builds: 25.1.1.1 and prior to 25.1.1.2, 25.1.2.2 and prior to 25.1.3.0 or 25.1.3.1, and 22.8R2.4 and prior to 22.8R2.5, with 22.7.x and below unaffected. Ivanti stated exploitation had occurred before disclosure affecting a limited number of customers.

findings.title: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-104935) - Rapid7 Attacker Behavior Analysis
findings.summary_md: Rapid7's Emergent Threat Response note ties the disclosure together: CVE-2026-104935 is a CWE-290 authentication bypass scoring CVSSv3 8.6, CISA added it to KEV the day of disclosure, and Ivanti said a portion of the flaw was found through its product security program and patched in the July 2026 release 25.1.3.0, with in-the-wild exploitation occurring while Ivanti backported the fix to remaining branches. It also flags that UTA0576's chain included a still-unpatched privilege escalation bug Ivanti planned to fix later. Rapid7 recommends emergency patching outside normal cycles, notes no reliable vendor IoCs at advisory time while Volexity published several, and says compromise hunting must continue even after patching.
